proof: Adopt a risk-tiered, tracer-pulled QUESTPIE v4 delivery process that preserves Kernel guarantees and machine-derived integrity while removing formal proof ceremony from ordinary Product increments.
acceptanceCriteria: Rigor is classified by the guarantee changed rather than a permanent feature taxonomy; Policy, nondisclosure, transaction, schema, artifact, ledger, dispatch, lease, fencing, cancellation, retry and checkpoint guarantees remain Kernel work wherever they appear.
Ordinary Product and tracer increments use TDD, integration tests, deterministic repository gates and normal review without proof heads, manual digest tables or fresh-model acceptance records.
The first current milestone establishes a browser-runnable compile-to-recovery skeleton, after which every capability lands in and preserves that skeleton before more contract breadth is designed.

Focused Kernel proof construction has a default two-working-day budget; unresolved claims shrink, split or defer, while missing evidence never becomes PASS and required deterministic database, load or soak execution is not truncated.

Formal stateless Opus-medium review remains pinned to the repository manifest protocol and is reserved for new or superseding public Kernel or architecture ADRs and exceptional release semantic boundaries.

Manual proof-head and canonical-artifact digest ledgers leave living process prose, while Runtime, artifact, migration, schema, identity, checkpoint and generated acceptance-packet integrity digests remain mandatory and tool-derived.

Autopilot is the second tracer: downstream handwritten deletion is reported as an adoption metric paired with runnable behavior and Kernel regressions, never as a correctness oracle or a gameable sole target.

Weekly deletion review treats unconsumed abstractions as candidates; Accepted public authority changes only through a focused superseding ADR, and named release compatibility seams remain valid consumers.

The candidate changes only the proposed ADR, candidate execution guide and acceptance manifest; Accepted ADRs, skill routing, contribution policy, handoff, proof map and production decision map are projected only after a PASS.
